description: This script verifies that non-binary files tracked in the Git index do not contain Unicode directional formatting characters that could be used to deceive reviewers. It excludes translation (`.po`) files and is tailored for an Ubuntu environment in a GitHub workflow.

methods.name: main logic (invoking git grep with regex)
methods.description: Performs a git grep to find files containing Unicode directional formatting characters, excluding binary and `.po` files

search-terms: LRE RLE PDF LRO RLO LRI RLI FSI PDI
